body: Proof in the app (emulator, real server, 6 Nov 2026): after the server linked seven tagged files (3 Fairuz in Arabic, 2 Kino in Russian, 2 Radiohead) the Fairuz album shows '1 song' and its only track is the Russian song 'Gruppa krovi'. Pictures and the full table: docs/evidence/README.md#d01. Also B-46 (the phone's matcher keeps every script, the server's folds to ASCII) and B-47 (tools/journeys/ui.py crashes on Arabic labels unless run with python -X utf8 -I): the walk of the native-script row needs both fixed. What a tap on a track of this library plays (the five Arabic and Russian files share one song) was not yet run.
